双頭の斧部隊の背後には、\n見たことのない巨大な機械装置があった。: Behind the Double-Headed Axe squad stood a massive mechanical device that none of us had ever seen before.
なんだ、あのアンテナみたいなでかい装置は……: What is that huge antenna-like device...
よーし、今度も負けないよ！: Alright, I'm not gonna lose this time either!
待て、迂闊に飛び込むな。\nまずあの装置がなんなのか確認しないとだろ。: Wait, don't dive in carelessly. We need to check what that device is first.
センサー確認……正体不明の超低周波音と、\n断続的なパルス信号……: Checking sensors... Unidentified infrasound and intermittent pulse signals...
あれが今回の異常スタンピードに何か影響を与えていそうだな……\nもしかしてメイズ: Looks like that thing is affecting this abnormal stampede... Could it be controlling the Maze Shifters...?
ごきげんよう、ユーロ・タワーのお嬢様方。\nこんな薄暗い場所でお散歩なんて……あ: Good day, ladies of Euro Tower. Taking a stroll in a gloomy place like this... Ah, could you perhaps be lost?
この異常なスタンピードを引き起こしたのは、あなた達ですね。\nその後ろの装置はそ: You're the ones who caused this abnormal stampede, aren't you? I take it that device behind you is meant for that purpose.
そうだと言ったら？: And what if I said yes?
罪なき人々を危険に晒すその行い、\n断じて許すことはできません。: Endangering innocent people through your actions is something I can never forgive.
はっ、さすがお嬢様。お綺麗なだけの言葉ね。: Ha, as expected of a sheltered young lady. Just pretty words.
ただちに、その後ろの装置を停止して投降しなさい……！: Shut down the device behind you and surrender immediately...!
私ね、昔から考えていたのよ。\n逃走する犯人に止まれと言って、止まるわけがないっ: You know, I've thought about this for a long time. Telling a fleeing criminal to stop isn't going to make them stop.
わたくし達も、できるだけ荒事にはしたくないのです。\n大人しく従っていただけるな: We don't want to resort to violence if we can avoid it. If you comply quietly, we will not attack.
そう言えばいい、という話なのよ。\n私の話、分かってる？: That's how you should say it. Do you get what I'm saying?
言葉遊びはどうでもいい。\nそれよりひとつだけ、はっきりさせておきたい。: Word games don't matter. More importantly, there's one thing I want to make clear.
メイズシフターを地上に誘導し暴走させたのは……\nお前達の仕業と考えていいんだな: Guiding the Maze Shifters to the surface and driving them wild... Can we assume that was your doing?
これは、対メイズシフター誘導装置『サイレン』――\n世界からつまはじきにされた私: This is the Anti-Maze Shifter Guidance Device, 'Siren'—a new 'power' built by us, who were ostracized by the world.
『力』を持つ者には責任が伴います。\nあなたはそれを……人を傷つけるために使って: With 'power' comes responsibility. And you are using it... to hurt people...
あら、生まれながらにして権力という絶対的な『力』を\n手にしている、『お貴族様』: My, my, to be lectured by 'noble folks' who hold the absolute 'power' of authority right from birth.
わたくし達は、誇りをもって……\nその力を弱き者を助けるために――与えるために使: We hold pride in using that power... to help the weak—to give to them.
どこまでも傲慢なのね。\n上から見下ろす側の存在っていつもそう。: How endlessly arrogant. Those who look down from above are always like this.
『持てる側』に立てた者の自己満足でしょう、そんなもの。: That kind of thing is just self-satisfaction for those standing on the side of the 'haves.'
な、なんだとっ！\nドロテア様の誇りを侮辱するな！: W-What did you say! Don't insult Dorothea-sama's pride!
『ストリート』――あのゴミ溜めみたいな場所に追いやられて、\n双頭の斧は生きてき: Pushed away into 'The Street'—that garbage dump of a place—that's how the Double-Headed Axe has survived.
私達『持たざる側』にお貴族様の誇りなんてものは\nこれっぽっちも理解できないわ。: We, the 'have-nots,' can't understand noble pride in the slightest.
何でも望めば与えられるあんた達に、どこにも行けず求めても得られず、\n日の当たる: Just like you, who are given whatever you wish for, can't understand the feelings of people who have nowhere to go, can't get what they seek, and can't even walk under the sun.
煌びやかなお屋敷で優雅にお茶飲んでると\n視界に入らないし、考えもしないんでしょ: When you're elegantly drinking tea in a gorgeous mansion, those things don't even enter your sight, nor do you ever think about them.
そんなことはないつもりです……！\nあなた方のような、か弱き者達にも――: I certainly don't intend for that to be the case...! Even to vulnerable people like you—
あぁ、それよ、それ。勝手に『弱者』と決めつけて無自覚に見下して、\nいちいち上か: Ah, that's it, right there. Arbitrarily labeling us as 'the weak,' looking down without even realizing it—can't you help others without acting condescending every single time?
これだから見下ろす側ってのは――: This is why people who look down on others are—
――劣等感、強すぎませんか？ あなた。: —Isn't your inferiority complex a bit too strong, lady?
黙って聞いていれば、コンプレックス丸出し……\n確かにあなた方のことなんて、知り: I've been listening quietly, and your complex is fully on display... True, I don't know anything about you guys.
皆さんが――いえ、特にコトハさん……でしたっけ。あなたがどんな\n存在に見下され: I don't know what kind of existence made all of you—no, especially Kotoha-san, was it?—feel looked down upon, driving you to carry such rage.
その怒りや憎しみのようなもの……きっと本物なのでしょう。: That anger and hatred... I'm sure it's genuine.
ですが……それをこっちに押し付けるのはやめてください。: However... please stop projecting it onto us.
私、別に貴族でもなんでもない、ただの平民ですが？: I'm not a noble or anything, I'm just a commoner, you know?
平民なのに、貴族のチームと一緒にいる……？: A commoner, yet you're with a team of nobles...?
正直今となっては、『融和の象徴』なんて言われても\n出来レースで仕組まれたただの: Honestly, even if people call us a 'symbol of harmony' now, it was just a rigged setup to serve as a billboard, but...
平民の私だからこそ、\n貴族であるドロテア先輩の代わりに言わせていただきます。: Precisely because I am a commoner, allow me to speak on behalf of Dorothea-senpai, who is a noble.
それでも私達は今、一緒にいます。隣に立っています。\n立ちたいと選んで、私は自分: Even so, we are together right now. Standing side by side. I chose to stand here, picking this 'place to belong' of my own free will.
与えられるのを口を開けて待っているのではなく、\n自分の中の『想い』に従って選ん: I didn't just sit with my mouth open waiting to be given things; I chose this by following the 'feelings' inside myself.
……そう。それで？\n貴族に媚び売って取り入ったヘコヘコ平民さんが何？: ...I see. So what? What does a groveling commoner who sucked up to nobles have to say?
弱くたっていいじゃないですか。そう思いません？\n施しを与えられてもいいじゃない: What's wrong with being weak? Don't you think so? What's wrong with accepting charity? Don't you feel that way?
上から目線？ 傲慢？ 当然でしょう。持ってる側からすれば、\n持ってない側はどこ: Condescending? Arrogant? Of course it is. From the perspective of the 'haves,' the 'have-nots' are always beneath them. That's reality.
でもだからこそ、ドロテア先輩は少しでもフェアになるように、\n与えようとするんじ: But that's precisely why Dorothea-senpai tries to give, tries to help, just to make things even a little bit fairer, isn't it?
それも理解できず、僻み感情丸出しでぶつくさ文句言って……\nそんなに建前が必要で: Failing to understand even that, grumbling with your envy on full display... Do you really need pretense that badly? Is your pride really that important to you?
私からすれば、もらえるものはもらっておけばいいって思いますけど。\nそれでちゃん: From my point of view, if you can get something, you should just take it. Then express proper gratitude and repay the favor someday.
まあ、決闘とかすんごい形で恩返しされる方もいますけどね……: Well, though there are some who repay favors in extreme ways, like duels...
どのような形であれ、誰かの尊く純粋な想い――\n誇りにケチつける資格なんてありま: No matter what form it takes, you have no right to belittle someone's noble, pure feelings—their pride.
特にあなたのように、\n与えるどころか人々から平穏を奪うような真逆の方には！: Especially someone like you, who does the exact opposite by stealing people's peace instead of giving!
……聞いていれば、そっちこそいい気になって！\nボスは行くところのないあたしらに: ...Listen to you getting all high and mighty! The Boss is the person who gave us a place to belong and a way to live when we had nowhere else to go!
そうだ！ お前らなんかにボスを悪く言う権利はない！: That's right! You guys have no right to speak ill of the Boss!
へえ、じゃあ……\nあなたも上から目線で傲慢になる『持てる』側だったんですね。: Heh, then... that means you were also on the side of the 'haves,' acting condescending and arrogant.
自覚、なかったんですか？: Did you not even realize it?
そうね……ひとつ考えを改めたわ。: I see... I've changed my mind about one thing.
世の中には、どれだけ話してもわかりあえない相手がいるってこと。: That in this world, there are opponents you can never understand no matter how much you talk.
……そんな無礼を承知でお願いします。\nどうかコトハを……止めてはくれませんか？: ...Knowing how rude this is, I ask you anyway. Could you please... stop Kotoha?
あるいは、助けてあげてほしいんです。: Or rather, I want you to save her.
は？ なに？ いきなり話に割り込んできて。: Huh? What? Barging into the conversation all of a sudden.
それでも俺は、お前ともっとちゃんと話がしたい。\nわかりあえないからこそ、もっと: Even so, I still want to talk to you properly. Precisely because we don't understand each other, we should converse more and deepen our understanding.
戦うんじゃなくて、助け合いたい。\nお前、本当に人々の平穏をただ脅かしたいだけな: Instead of fighting, I want us to help each other. Do you really just want to threaten people's peace?
本当は何か、別に目的があるんじゃないか？\nそれも実は俺達とは何も相反しないよう: Isn't there actually some other goal? One that doesn't actually conflict with ours at all—
バカバカしい。あんたの想いなんて知ったこっちゃないわ。\n話は終わりよ！: Ridiculous. I couldn't care less about your feelings. Talk time is over!
私達は直接手を下すつもりはないわ。\n相手は……こいつらで十分。: We don't intend to lay a hand on you directly. For opponents... these guys are enough.
コトハ達は攻撃を仕掛けてはこない。\nその代わり『サイレン』がこれまでと違う信号: Kotoha and her squad didn't attack us. Instead, 'Siren' emitted a signal different from before.
くっ……！ いきなり、こんなに大量に……！？: Ngh...! So many all at once...!?
周囲から出現した大量のメイズシフターが俺達を襲う。\nしかも半狂乱と言っていいほ: A massive swarm of Maze Shifters appeared from all around and attacked us. Moreover, their aggressiveness had increased to a point that could be called half-frenzied.
全機、迎撃態勢をとれ！\n来るぞ！！: All units, assume interception posture! Here they come!!
